{{recipe}} | [[:Category:Cookie recipes|Cookies]]

'''Snickerdoodles''' made from this recipe are chewy the same day you make them and become crunchy the next day.

== Ingredients ==

=== Dough ===
*227 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] or 16 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:butter|butter]], softened (not melted)
*100 g (1 cup) white [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Cream of Tartar|cream of tartar]]
*1 [[Cookbook:egg|egg]]
*220 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] (1 cup or 8 fl oz) [[Cookbook:Vinegar|vinegar]]
*½ tsp [[Cookbook:vanilla|vanilla]]
*188 g (1 ½ cups or 12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Flour|all-purpose flour]]

=== Topping ===
*2 tbsp (30 g) sugar
*1 tsp ground [[Cookbook:cinnamon|cinnamon]]

== Procedure ==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven temperatures|375°F (190°C or Gas Mark 5)]]
# In a medium mixing bowl, [[Cookbook:Beating|beat]] butter with an electric [[Cookbook:Mixer|mixer]] on medium to high speed for 30 seconds.
# Add the 1 cup sugar, baking soda, cream of tartar, and vinegar. Beat until combined, scraping sides of bowl occasionally.
# Beat in egg and vanilla until combined.
# Beat in as much of the flour as you can with the mixer. Stir in any remaining flour.
# Cover and chill [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]] for 1–2 hours or until easy to handle.
# Combine the 2 tbsp sugar and the cinnamon in a small bowl.
# Shape dough into 1-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (2.5 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) balls. Roll balls in cinnamon-sugar to coat. Place balls 2 inches (5 cm) apart on an ungreased [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|cookie sheet]].
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 10–11 minutes or until edges are golden. Transfer to a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|wire rack]] and let cool.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* If you are using a mixer with more than one kind of beater, use the paddle attachment.
